==After completion of The Restless Ghost==
* '''Father Aereck:''' Welcome to this church of holy Saradomin.
* {{tselect|Select an option}}
* {{topt|Could you tell me more about prayers?}}
** '''Player:''' Could you tell me about prayers?
** '''Father Aereck:''' Ah, of course. Saradomin looks kindly upon his most devout followers, and is more than willing to provide them with powerful benefits.
** '''Player:''' So prayers are specifically a Saradomin thing?
** '''Father Aereck:''' Well, I suppose you could pray to other gods... but I don't know why you'd want to. What could any other god possibly offer that Saradomin does not already provide?
** '''Player:''' I guess I was just curious. Anyway, what are these benefits that come from prayers?
** '''Father Aereck:''' Well, an adventurer like you may find them very useful in battle. They can make you stronger, letting you defeat powerful enemies with ease.
** '''Father Aereck:''' Alternatively, they can offer you protection, stopping you from suffering any harm from certain kinds of attacks.
** {{tbox|sprite=902 icon.png|Prayers are powerful passive abilities that you can activate to give you an advantage in combat. You can activate and deactivate prayers from within the Prayer panel.}}
** '''Father Aereck:''' Now, you should know that the benefits from praying are not freely given. It requires continued focus and faith to be able to use them.
** {{tbox|sprite=8819 icon.png|Using prayers will drain your Prayer Points, with stronger ones draining Prayer Points faster than weaker ones. Your current Prayer Points are shown in the orb next to your minimap.}}
** '''Player:''' Is there a good way for me to make sure I don't lose my faith?
** '''Father Aereck:''' Well, that's what altars like the one in this church are for!
** {{tbox|pic=9714 detail.png|Once you've run out of Prayer Points, you'll need to restore them before you can use any prayers again. Prayer Points can be restored at an altar. To find an altar, just look for the relevant icon on your map.}}
** '''Player:''' I see. Is there anything else I should know?
** '''Father Aereck:''' There is. The greater benefits of praying are only granted to those who show their dedication to Saradomin.
** '''Player:''' And how do I do that?
** '''Father Aereck:''' If you pay your respects to the dead by burying their bones, you will very much gain his favour.
** {{tbox|pic=Bones detail.png|Prayer XP is gained by burying bones. The higher your Prayer level, the more Prayer Points you will have available, and the more prayers you'll be able to use.}}
** '''Father Aereck:''' And I think that covers pretty much everything. I'm sure you'll still learn an extra thing or two while out on your adventures though.
** {{tbox|sprite=898 icon.png|To learn more about Prayer, see the guide for it in the Skills panel.}}
** '''Player:''' Thanks!
** {{tact|other}}
* {{topt|Could you tell me more about Saradomin?}}
** '''Player:''' Could you tell me more about Saradomin?
** '''Father Aereck:''' Surely you must know of Saradomin? He is the god of all that is good in this world! A bastion of order and peace against Zamorak and other gods of evil!
** '''Father Aereck:''' There's a reason why the Church of Saradomin is by far the largest religion in all these lands!
** {{tselect|Select an option}}
** {{topt|I see. Thanks for the information.}}
** '''Player:''' I see. Thanks for the information.
** '''Father Aereck:''' It's not a problem... though I really am surprised you didn't already know about Saradomin...
